entities.summary: Lake Brosno is a lake situated in the European part of Russia, in the Tver region, near the town of Andreapol. It is the place where the Brosno dragon, the lake monster in Russian folklore, is supposed to live. The lake's depth is about 43 meters at its deepest point, and it has a sunken church in its western part. Among the fish that inhabit the lake are perch and burbot.
